title: Technical Implementation Specialist
location: Atlanta, GA Atlanta, GA Austin, Texas
description:
Revinate is the hotel data activation platform for hotels, groups, resorts, and enterprise brands.
Every hotel has that guest: years of stays, the same room, never skips the spa. But their story sits scattered across the PMS, the booking engine, the spa system, and whoever happened to be on shift. Revinate brings that story together. We connect and clean guest data from every system into Rich Guest Profile® data, then put it to work for the people who look after guests.
Reservations answers the phone already knowing the guest. Marketing sends the spa offer to the guest who raved about the spa. Behind it all, Ivy, our AI intelligence layer trained on 17 years of hospitality data, reads the patterns and handles the digital labor.
Revinate powers 1.1 billion Rich Guest Profile® data points across 12,500+ hotels, driving over $24 billion in direct revenue.
Get Revinate. Get superpowers.

Top 3 Outcomes for Year One
Develop a strong foundational knowledge of all Revinate SaaS products and the configuration processes required to implement them.
 Independently configure and manage customer accounts for multiple core product implementations simultaneously, handling both standard rollouts and complex integrations.
 Become an expert on advanced configuration requirements and tier-two tickets, providing cross-functional technical support and resolutions within designated SLA timeframes.
What You’ll Do
Implementation & Project Execution
 Lead the customer implementation process end to end, serving as the primary technical point of contact to ensure on-time delivery and a smooth onboarding experience across the entire SaaS product suite.
 Gather detailed customer requirements and accurately convert them into comprehensive system configurations across multiple product lines to achieve the client's desired outcomes.
 Organize and lead effective internal and external project meetings, proactively communicating expectations, procedures, and requirements to all stakeholders.
 Technical Configuration & Integration
 Execute and manage the hands-on back-end technical setup, customization, and configuration of diverse SaaS systems and solutions.
 Coordinate with third-party software vendors to acquire necessary technical details and secure required resources for complex system integrations.
 Validate the correct implementation and intended functionality of all technical components, ensuring seamless communication between internal systems and external integrations.
 Quality Assurance & Troubleshooting
 Perform rigorous quality assurance (QA) and thorough testing of product functionality and performance metrics prior to project closure and official launch.
 Resolve real-time technical product issues encountered during onboarding, utilizing critical thinking to troubleshoot and perform back-end adjustments.
 Review customer inquiries, research complex technical issues, and provide timely resolutions or escalate to management and engineering when necessary.
 Customer Enablement & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) on the platform, advising customers on how to maximize the value of their services and providing solutions for potential obstacles during live calls.
 Act as a critical liaison between the customer and internal product/engineering teams, advocating for customer-requested enhancements to drive continuous product improvement.
 Manage ongoing project documentation, including the creation, maintenance, and distribution of internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and knowledge resources to enhance service quality.
 Supplementary Product Support (Telephony)
 Handle supplementary telecommunications tasks as needed, including managing toll-free and local number inventory, performing routine audits, and executing off-program workflows in accordance with carrier protocols and internal SOPs.
What You’ll Bring
An associate's degree or equivalent training, plus at least two (2) years of professional experience in a Project Management, Implementation, or Technical Configuration role.
 Demonstrated ability to successfully manage a high volume of simultaneous, ongoing implementation projects and competing priorities.
 Strong technical aptitude with a proven ability to quickly learn new SaaS technologies and master basic to intermediate product features in a fast timeframe.
 Exceptional problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify complex technical issues and evaluate, recommend, and implement back-end solutions.
 Intermediate to advanced proficiency with MS Office Suite and Google Workspace; experience using tools to track project deliverables and milestones.
 Flexible and adaptable to changing time zone requirements necessary to support internal and external customers.
 Preferred Qualifications / Nice-to-Have
 Practical experience with technical SaaS software configuration and managing complex system integrations.
 Familiarity with hospitality systems, specifically Property Management Systems (PMS) such as Opera, roomMaster, or Maestro.
 Previous experience with telephony-related products, network routing, or telecom configuration.
 Experience with project management and support software such as Zendesk, JIRA, Asana, Rocketlane, Salesforce, and SendGrid.
People Describe You As
Extremely detail-oriented: You excel at following established practices and ensuring that your technical configurations are carried out with absolute precision.
 A master communicator: You are highly effective at building rapport with customers and internal teams alike. You do not hesitate to jump on a call with a customer to explain a technical setup, test an account, or troubleshoot an issue.
 Flexible and fluid: You excel at managing multiple projects with unique needs, recognizing and applying patterns to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding innovative solutions to challenges as they arise.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless.  That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses.
 About the role 
 At Airtable, we are passionate about how our product democratizes software creation and empowers teams to build applications that connect their organization and drive outcomes, no code needed. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the post-sales owner for a portfolio of enterprise customers, guiding them from onboarding through renewal as they adopt Airtable and our AI capabilities. You will help customers turn AI adoption and workflow innovation into measurable business outcomes, and you will partner closely with Account Executives so they can focus on growth.
 Customer Success at Airtable sits at the nexus of our Sales, Product and Marketing teams. We hire Customer Success Managers into one of two teams (Scaled and High Touch), depending on your experience and where our team needs you most. We will talk with you about which team is the best fit during the interview process.
 What you'll do
 Serve as the post-sales point of contact for your accounts, guiding customers to the right answer or the right Airtable team when you cannot resolve something yourself
 Drive onboarding excellence, working with customers on a mutual plan so their primary workflows launch within 90 days, with governance and best practices in place from the start
 Build joint success plans with customers focused on AI adoption, business outcomes and operational efficiency
 Lead Executive Business Reviews and data-driven value reviews that document ROI, surface risk and identify growth
 Develop champions across existing users so each account has multiple advocates who can sustain adoption
 Deliver enablement that accelerates adoption: Airtable 101, feature-specific sessions, AI and MCP workshops, and hands-on build sessions
 Guide governance conversations, including license deployment, long-term app strategy and stakeholder orchestration
 Run workflow consultations for new use cases and determine the right build path
 Monitor account health, adoption trends and risk signals, and flag risk early to your Account Executive and the Renewals team
 Qualify expansion opportunities and hand them to your Account Executive with context
 Maintain a current account record: use cases, success stories, ROI and a stakeholder map, refreshed quarterly
 Serve as the voice of the customer internally, translating usage and feedback into insights that shape our product and AI roadmap, and partner with Marketing and Product on customer stories
 Develop reusable frameworks, AI-enabled health insights and playbooks that scale customer impact across the enterprise segment
 Who you are
 You have 5+ years of experience in enterprise customer success, account management, solutions consulting or technical account management supporting B2B SaaS or workflow automation platforms
 You have a track record of delivering measurable results for customers through onboarding, adoption, retention and expansion
 You have owned relationships with multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts and are comfortable being the customer's primary contact
 You have technical fluency and can guide both business and technical audiences. You are comfortable discussing workflow automation, integrations and data, and you have a working understanding of AI and how customers apply it to real workflows
 You are a teacher at heart, able to distill technical or intricate systems into clear, actionable guidance, with strong facilitation, storytelling and presentation skills
 You are skilled at building success plans, running business reviews and mapping platform capabilities to customer outcomes
 You are organized and detail-oriented, and can prioritize across a large portfolio without losing sight of the "why" behind the "what"
 You partner well with Sales and are at ease working alongside Account Executives, Renewals, Support and Services on a shared account
 You are a team player and a self-starter who can operate in a motion that is still being refined
 Nice to have
 Experience with no-code or low-code platforms, workflow automation tools or AI-driven SaaS products
 Background in management consulting, product management or solution architecture within enterprise technology
 Experience designing AI-powered workflows or using LLMs to improve customer operations
 Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools for quantifying customer value
 Understanding of enterprise governance, change management and security frameworks relevant to SaaS adoption

We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. title: Senior Director of Implementation
description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



As the Senior Director, Implementation, you’ll report to the Vice President, Customer Success and set the strategic and operational direction for 1Password’s implementation and professional services function. You’ll lead a team responsible for helping customers across Small and Medium-sized Businesses (SMB), Commercial, and Enterprise segments adopt 1Password successfully, improve time to value, and achieve measurable outcomes.



How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - Bring 10+ years of experience in professional services, customer onboarding, or implementation, including at least 5 years in a leadership role, with experience in cybersecurity and Software as a Service (SaaS) environments.

 - Demonstrate a strong background in technical implementations, systems, infrastructure, and integrations for complex customers.

 - Apply experience from implementation, professional services, solutions architecture, or technical account management environments.

 - Scale onboarding and implementation programs across SMB, Commercial, and Enterprise customer segments.

 - Build capacity-planning models and use utilization, delivery performance, and other Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to guide decisions.

 - Combine strategic thinking with a willingness to engage directly in complex customer situations, team challenges, and operational details.

 - Influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners through clear communication, sound judgment, data, and a strong understanding of customer and business needs.





What you can expect:

 - Define and execute the strategic vision for implementation and professional services, including the launch and evolution of scalable services offerings.

 - Lead, coach, and grow a cross-functional team of Solutions Architects, Onboarding Specialists, Project Managers, and Implementation Specialists.

 - Establish scalable playbooks, frameworks, and processes that improve onboarding, implementation quality, customer adoption, and time to value.

 - Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, and Operations to create effective transitions from pre-sale activities through customer implementation.

 - Oversee implementation delivery across customer segments, ensuring projects meet scope, timeline, quality, and outcome expectations.

 - Use data and reporting to monitor project health, capacity, utilization, customer outcomes, and opportunities for improvement.

 - Serve as an escalation point for complex implementation challenges while leading change initiatives that strengthen team effectiveness and customer results.





USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $192,000 USD and $288,000 USD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $182,000 CAD and $273,000 CAD. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password’s generous benefits program (health, dental, RRSP and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.



Our culture 
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first. 

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. title: Customer Onboarding Manager - USA
description:
Help make the world more hospitable 
 The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.
 You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.
 If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.
 About the role 
 Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:
 You will own the customer relationship from handover to go-live, guiding hotels through setup, training and rollout so the platform works for them from day one. Each go-live is the first real test of whether Mews fits the way a property runs, and the quality of that experience shapes whether a customer stays and grows with us. Mews serves hotels across EMEA, and the portfolio is large enough that how well you onboard is felt in the numbers.
 As a Customer Onboarding Manager, you run several mid-market and enterprise implementations at the same time, often phased across multiple properties or regions. You work with customer stakeholders on one side and with Sales, Support and RevOps on the other, so that what was agreed in the sale is what gets delivered at go-live.
 The problem this role solves sits in the period between signing and a working go-live. Configuration choices, integration issues and timeline slips that surface late are costly for the customer and for us. You spot them early, make risk-informed trade-offs, and give customers credible advice on setup so they adopt the product and are ready to run on it.
 What you would do 
 Run several onboarding projects at once, at different stages and levels of complexity, within SLA targets, including phased rollouts across multiple properties and regions
 Configure the product for each customer, diagnose integration issues, and advise on setup decisions, flagging configuration, data and timeline risks early
 Train customer stakeholders with different needs, drive adoption through to go-live, and keep Sales, Support and RevOps aligned along the way
 Use AI to draft documentation, prepare for customer sessions and keep project tracking efficient
 Check AI-generated material for accuracy before it reaches a customer or colleague, and share what works with the team
 AI Fluency Level 2: In this role, AI is part of your regular working week, for example drafting customer documentation, preparing for training sessions and keeping project tracking tidy, and it makes you noticeably faster and better at onboarding work. Just as important, you check what it gives you: you read it critically, correct it, and only share it with a customer or colleague once you are sure it is accurate.
 For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates on Confluence. 
 What you would bring 
 3 to 5 years in SaaS onboarding, implementation or customer-facing technical roles
 Experience managing concurrent mid-market or enterprise implementations, including phased rollouts across multiple properties or regions
 Deep SaaS product knowledge: you can configure complex products, diagnose integration issues and advise customers credibly on setup decisions
 Strong communication and training skills for diverse customer stakeholders, stakeholder management across customers, Sales, Support and RevOps, and structured project management across several projects at once
 AI Fluency Level 2 in your day-to-day work, with strong discernment: you critically evaluate AI output before sharing it with customers or colleagues
 Nice to have 
 Experience in hospitality technology or an adjacent sector (hotel management, PMS, POS, payments), or familiarity with Mews Hospitality Cloud or a comparable multi-module SaaS platform
 Multilingual, relevant for EMEA portfolio coverage
 Experience contributing to onboarding playbooks, SOPs or team knowledge bases, or using AI tools to draft training materials, automate repetitive documentation or manage project tracking
 United States 
 $92,000 — $98,000 USD 
 Pay Transparency at Mews 
 Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.
 This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.
 If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.
 What’s in it for you? 
 Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.
 Global benefits 
 No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:
 Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
 Participation in our company share program
 Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
 An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
 Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
 A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
 Relocation options, available

title: Client Experience Specialist, New Construction
description:
About the team
The Senior Specialist, Account Services supports Zillow’s account-focused teams by managing moderately complex operational workflows, resolving issues, and coordinating with cross-functional partners to deliver a consistent, high-quality experience for customers and internal stakeholders. This role uses data, standardized processes, and strong communication skills to ensure account activities are executed accurately, risks are identified early, and opportunities to improve service and efficiency are surfaced and implemented. About the role
 As a Client Experience Specialist on the New Construction team, you will onboard and educate home builders on how to get the most from Zillow's New Construction products. You will partner with sales to set new advertisers up for success, manage a team book of business, and resolve issues that come up after launch. If you are detail-oriented and self-driven and want to build a career with the nation's largest real estate network, this role is for you.
 You Will Get To: 
 Onboard new home builder clients and guide them through the full launch process
 Resolve issues that arise after launch
 Educate clients on capturing high-quality content for their New Construction listings
 Partner with sales to set new advertisers up for success by accurately explaining how listings and display products work
 Manage a team book of business across the New Construction advertising lifecycle, including self-serve and small-to-medium business partners through a shared case queue
 Build deep knowledge of New Construction products, features, and CES internal workflows
 Use sound judgment to solve complex customer and internal problems
 Communicate openly with customers and teammates across departments
 This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $35.60 - $56.80 hourly. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $33.80 - $54.00 hourly. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are
 You bring 3+ years of customer service experience + BA Degree
 You communicate clearly in writing, by phone, and in person, with a positive, can-do attitude.
 You manage your time well, act quickly on requests, and work with minimal instruction.
 You take ownership of your work and deliver accurately, with strong attention to detail, in a fast-changing environment.
 You have a working understanding of Salesforce (Lightning) and track your activity consistently.
 You are comfortable with Gmail and Google Drive and learn new systems quickly.
 Experience in online advertising sales is a plus.
 You are able to travel to zRetreats at least twice a year.
 Here at Zillow - we value the experience and perspective of candidates with non-traditional backgrounds. We encourage you to apply if you have transferable skills or related experiences.
 Get to know us
 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.
 How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. 
 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
 Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Customer Success Project Manager
description:
Amid clinical workforce shortages, rising healthcare costs, and ongoing concerns about inequity, IMPaCT unlocks the power of the grassroots community health workforce.
 Here at IMPaCT Care , we get out of bed every day to change lives, with the most effective intervention in the world for addressing health inequity. We find, train and enable Community Health Workers to make magic: caring people who keep their communities healthy. We have built the largest and most scientifically proven Community Health Worker platform in the country, used across 22 states by 70+ organizations like Kaiser Permanente, CVS and United Way. Across multiple randomized controlled trials, IMPaCT has achieved outcomes frequently believed to be out of reach, including $2,500 in annual savings per patient, improved mental health and a Net Promoter Score of 94. There is even a new Medicare billing code for Community Health Workers that is modeled after IMPaCT!
 We are changing the game, but also know the importance of enjoying the journey. We provide competitive compensation and equity grants, comprehensive benefits and plenty of opportunities for team building and fun. Plus you get to work from home.
 Curious? Read on.
 Who You Are 
 You are the person who keeps the plan. When 6 people are talking at once on a customer call about data files, go-live dates and who owns what, you are already typing the action items, assigning owners and setting due dates. By the time the call ends, your recap is ready to send.
 An air traffic controller: you run a 200-task Asana plan across several customers and always know what is landing next.
 A live capture pro: you think while you type, and you organize as you go. Notes land in the right place the first time.
 One step ahead: like a great surgical tech who hands over the next instrument before anyone asks, you anticipate what the team and the customer will need next.
 Unafraid of complexity: Medicare, Medicaid, SFTP, eligibility files. When you hear a term you do not know, you ask, learn it and use it correctly the next time.
 Warm and professional: you welcome customers to a call, deliver hard news with calm and kindness, and guide people through change.
 Here to master the craft: you love this kind of work and want to grow in it.
 What You Will Do 
 Run the plan 
 Build project plans that work backward from customer goals, tracking every deliverable, owner and deadline.
 Capture decisions and next steps in real time in Asana and Salesforce (for example, "Per 6/15 discussion, Sunbelt will pilot new workflows by Q3").
 Act as the hub between internal teams (Product, Tech, Workforce Development, Clinical) and hold everyone to the timeline.
 See around corners 
 Spot risks early and flag them before they become blockers.
 Know what to solve on your own and when to escalate.
 Prepare customers for delays and tradeoffs before they become surprises.
 Deliver for customers 
 Partner with a Director of Clinical Strategy to support 4-12 healthcare customers, depending on complexity.
 Coordinate end-to-end Community Health Worker program launches and platform adoption.
 Prepare agendas, decks and quarterly business reviews, and pull customer reports.
 Own the Tech Review process with customer IT and compliance teams.
 Triage a steady flow of email, Slack and customer requests so nothing is missed.
 What You Bring 
 Required: a Bachelor's degree and a project management certification (PMP or CAPM). 
 2+ years managing complex projects, implementations, or operations with external customers or partners.
 A track record of managing concurrent projects with zero dropped balls.
 The ability to turn a long discussion into a 1-page summary executives love.
 Hands-on skill with Asana or a similar tool, the Google suite, Zoom and a CRM such as Salesforce.
 Ability to work primarily during Eastern Time business hours.
 Occasional travel for team retreats and customer site visits.
 Nice to have: familiarity with U.S. healthcare (health systems, payers, community-based organizations) or experience at a health tech or SaaS startup.
 Our Hiring Process 
 Live note-taking is central to this role, so we test it early. After you apply and answer a few short questions, selected candidates complete a short live note-taking exercise and a screening interview, followed by a project plan exercise and team interviews.
 IMPaCT Care is committed to providing an inclusive interview experience. If you need any accommodations to participate fully, please let us know.
 One of our core values is to create a diverse workplace that welcomes and values each team member's unique perspective, background and ideas. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. 
Salary: $75,000 – $95,000 / year Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Onboarding Specialist
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
 Fullsteam is a leading provider of vertical software and embedded payments technology dedicated to helping businesses flourish by providing their customers with seamless experiences. With a dynamic and growing team of over 1,900 employees, we are committed to driving innovation and delivering best-in-class software and payment solutions that empower small and medium-sized businesses across numerous industries. Our purpose is to help our customers grow their businesses and delight their customers. Join us and be a part of a forward-thinking company that values growth, excellence, and the success of our clients.
 Fullsteam is a leading provider of integrated payments and business management software solutions. Within the Healthcare & Practice Management vertical, we empower medical, dental, and other healthcare providers with innovative, cloud-based software that streamlines operations, enhances patient engagement, and improves financial performance. Our solutions help practices efficiently manage scheduling, billing, compliance, and payments, allowing them to focus on delivering quality patient care.
 The Onboarding Specialist is responsible for onboarding and training new customers, providing product expertise, and supporting client success through effective education, guidance, and advocacy. This role works closely with customers and cross-functional teams to drive customer satisfaction, retention, and adoption while serving as a knowledgeable resource on products, integrations, and industry requirements.
 Primary Responsibilities:
 Onboard and train new users in a professional and timely manner using OnRamp.
 Assist with initial set up with integrated partners.
 Seek opportunities to increase customer value and ensure client retention by acting as a client advocate. Look for solutions, rather than answers.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure client satisfaction.
 Assist customer support team with coverage as needed.
 Support the sales team with prospective clients by providing technical and product support during the sales process.
 Maintain awareness of the changing healthcare landscape and new industry requirements.
 Serve as a subject matter expert at industry trade shows. Stay current with feature launches, policy changes and product integrations.

title: Manager, Operational Key Account Manager
description:
About Ascent
 Ascent Global Logistics , headquartered in Belleville, Michigan, is a leading global provider of expedited, time-critical logistics solutions and other direct transportation services. The company connects customers to its extensive carrier network, internal ground fleet and airline via its proprietary, digital PEAK freight marketplace, which provides robust carrier capacity and transparent pricing, backed by 24/7/365 logistics experts. Ascent’s offerings include air charter and ground expedited solutions as well as truckload, less-than-truckload, global forwarding, brokerage, and managed transportation services. The experienced Ascent team solves customers’ most challenging logistics needs by providing industry-leading service and top-tier satisfaction.
 Our Guiding Principles
 At the core of Ascent's culture is a strong commitment to excellence, driven by the passion and dedication of every team member. We're equally dedicated to going above and beyond for our customers, ensuring this commitment extends beyond our team and brings exceptional value to those we serve. We aim for perfect execution in everything we do and ‘play hard’ by creating an environment where tasks are performed with a can-do attitude from start to finish. We ‘play smart’ by delivering on our commitments in an honest, fair and ethical manner. We treat every person with whom we interface with the utmost dignity and respect. We understand that our teammates are our most valuable assets, so we ‘play together’ by making every effort to provide a professional and enjoyable experience, enabling careers to flourish and personal growth to be achieved.
 ROLE SUMMARY
 The Operational Key Account Manager (OKAM) is the performance owner of a portfolio of Ascent’s most important key account customers. The role is accountable for end-to-end service performance — SLAs, KPIs, continuous improvement, and cost-to-serve — across the assigned accounts. The OKAM runs the day-to-day operational cadence, owns issue resolution, and ensures Ascent delivers consistent, measurable execution on the commercial commitments made by the Growth KAM. Working closely with Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance, the OKAM turns performance data into customer-facing insight and continuous improvement — a hands-on, execution-focused role for a disciplined operational leader.
 KEY ACTIVITIES
 The six most important activities of the role: 
 Own Day-to-Day Service Performance — Accountable for SLA/KPI delivery (OTIF, TTFB, claims, win/capture) across the assigned account portfolio; run the weekly and monthly operational cadence with the customer.
 Drive Continuous Improvement & Savings — Lead the CI roadmap for each account — identify systemic issues, deliver measurable cost-to-serve and OTIF improvements, and convert performance trends into documented savings.
 Lead Root-Cause Analysis & CAPA — Own issue resolution, root-cause investigation, and corrective/preventive action for escalations; close the loop with Operations and the customer on sustainable fixes.
 Maintain SOPs & Operational Governance — Design, maintain, and govern the account SOPs; ensure cross-regional consistency and smooth onboarding of new lanes, modes, or scopes awarded by the Growth KAM.
 Deliver Performance Visibility via Power BI — Own the customer’s KPI dashboards and scorecards; turn Power BI data into structured performance narratives for internal reviews and customer QBRs.
 Coordinate Cross-Functional Execution — Act as the central bridge between the customer’s operational teams, Ascent Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance; ensure one coordinated service delivery for the customer.
 WHAT YOU WILL BRING
 The successful candidate brings the following qualifications, experience, and education: 
 Work Experience
 6+ years of progressive operational experience in logistics, supply chain, or freight forwarding — with a proven track record of managing complex, multi-modal customer accounts.
 Demonstrated success owning SLA/KPI performance (OTIF, claims, cost-to-serve) across global, multi-region customer footprints.
 Hands-on experience leading continuous improvement initiatives that delivered measurable savings and service-level uplift.
 Proven ability to run root-cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone, CAPA) and drive systemic corrective actions with Operations.
 Experience authoring and governing SOPs, account playbooks, and onboarding documentation for complex customer flows.
 Qualifications & Skills
 Strong operational mindset — disciplined, detail-oriented, and relentless about execution against the SLA.
 Analytical and data-driven — expert-level Power BI and Excel for KPI reporting, trend analysis, and customer scorecards.
 Excellent communication skills — confident presenting service performance to senior customer stakeholders in QBRs and issue reviews.
 Proven cross-functional collaboration with Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance without direct authority.
 Knowledge of CargoWise or equivalent TMS, PEAK Marketplace integrations, and shipment-level data flows a strong plus.
 Bilingual (English / Spanish) a plus, given cross-border US-MX account scope.
 Educational Background
 Bachelor’s degree required — preferably in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
 Advanced degree (MBA, MS in Supply Chain / Operations) a plus.
 Relevant professional certifications strongly preferred — APICS / CSCP, Lean Six Sigma (Green or Black Belt), PMP, or equivalent.

 At Wipfli , people count.

 Wipfli is continuing to build its Commercial Operations capability, and we’re looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to ambiguity and turning business needs into practical solutions.

title: Discretionary Equity Portfolio Manager
location: Remote Hong Kong Singapore United States
description:
Company Overview 
 hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.
 Job Overview 
 As an exceptional portfolio manager with a demonstrable track record, you will build and manage a discretionary, event-driven long-short equity portfolio across US equities. The initial focus will be on crypto-related equities, complementing our existing digital asset business and drawing on the firm’s knowledge and research capabilities, with flexibility to pursue compelling opportunities across the broader US equity universe. 
 This is an opportunity to help shape the firm’s expansion into a new asset class. Working closely with the firm’s leadership, you will have significant ownership of the strategy, areas of focus, and portfolio approach, while helping establish the capabilities needed to support and scale your trading activity. 
 You will have extensive support and resources at your disposal. hermeneutic’s specialized trading business, research-driven culture, and technology and data infrastructure provide a foundation on which to build. You will collaborate with researchers, traders, and engineers to adapt and extend these capabilities to support discretionary equity trading.
 This role offers ownership across the full investment lifecycle, from idea generation and catalyst analysis through portfolio construction, trade execution, and risk management. With trading horizons ranging from days to months, you will combine independent investment judgment with disciplined risk-taking to identify asymmetric opportunities and deliver consistent, risk-adjusted performance across different market environments. 
 If you are an experienced discretionary equity portfolio manager with a strong track record and the ambition to develop and scale a high-performing portfolio, we encourage you to apply.
 Key Responsibilities
 Develop, manage, and continually refine a discretionary, event-driven long-short equity trading strategy.
 Draw on the firm’s digital asset expertise to inform crypto-related equity trades, while independently sourcing opportunities across the broader US equity universe.
 Translate investment views into portfolio positions, with responsibility for portfolio construction, position sizing, trade execution, and risk management.
 Maintain a disciplined investment process and adapt positioning as market conditions, catalysts, and risk/reward dynamics evolve.
 Collaborate with researchers, traders, and engineers to develop and apply the firm’s capabilities to research, portfolio monitoring, and execution.
 Take ownership of portfolio performance, with a focus on generating consistent, risk-adjusted returns while operating within the firm’s risk framework.
 Requirements
 Must-Haves 
 A degree in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.
 At least 5 years of relevant equity trading or investment experience, ideally in a hedge fund, proprietary trading firm, or other institutional investment firm.
 A demonstrable, attributable track record in discretionary long-short equity trading, ideally with an event-driven focus, supported by historical performance data available for review.
 An interest in applying equity trading expertise to crypto-related companies; prior research or trading experience in the sector is preferred.
 Strong risk management discipline, with a clear understanding of portfolio volatility, drawdown management, and capital preservation.
 Experience independently managing capital, including portfolio construction, position sizing, and investment decision-making.
 Strong research and analytical skills to assess catalysts, event timing, market expectations, and risk/reward, and translate differentiated views into actionable trades.
 Interview Process 
 CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
 HR Interview – If further clarification is needed, a brief call may be scheduled to better understand your background.
 Portfolio Manager Interview – A discussion of your investment experience, trading approach, and risk management.
 CIO Interview – A concluding discussion to assess your capabilities, strategic thinking, and cultural fit.
 Company Values 
 Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:
 Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
 Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
 Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
 Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
 Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
